newsitem.title: USA: ADVISORY-API, EIA, AGA schedule for Jan 19 week.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY-API, EIA, AGA schedule for Jan 19 week.

text.p: The American Petroleum Institute said Tuesday that due to the Martin Luther King holiday next Monday its weekly national petroleum report, which is usually issued on Tuesday, will be delayed one day to Wednesday, Jan. 22, after 1630 EST (2130 GMT).
The Energy Information Administration said its weekly U.S. petroleum data, usually issued on Wednesday, will also be delayed one day to Thursday, Jan. 23, at 0900 EST (1400 GMT).
The American Gas Association said its weekly underground storage data will be released as usual on Wednesday, Jan. 22, after 1600 EST (2100 GMT).
